reason: A governance workflow plugin for AI coding projects that structures evidence-backed planning, stage gates, review, risk tracking, validation, and release readiness using project-local records and optional local web summaries.

summaries.zh: 面向 AI 编程项目的治理工作流插件，用于组织基于证据的规划、阶段门、评审、风险、验证和发布准备记录。
summaries.en: A governance workflow plugin for AI coding projects that organizes evidence-backed planning, stage gates, reviews, risks, validation, and release readiness records.

capabilities: Runs local validation and workflow-checking scripts
May configure or use git hooks
Provides agent loading adapters and skill instructions
Provides a read-only local web dashboard and summary endpoints
